answer_1.quote: we introduce the novel task of self-disclosure abstraction, with the goal of rephrasing disclosure spans into less specific words without losing the utility or essence of the message.

answer_2.quote: We adopt matching BLEU and ROUGE metrics proposed by [citation] to encourage diversity in generated abstractions.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a human evaluation on 60 sampled self-disclosure test instances.
answer_4.guideline: We then evaluate the top two models on four aspects: privacy increase, utility preservation, and diversity, all rated on a 1-5 Likert scale, along with a binary assessment of coherence.
